messages:
Alex Chen: Quick design check — proposing updates to Deployments/create form validation and delete flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Deployments-forms (frames 5-8). TL;DR: inline errors (on-blur), compact top summary for submit/server errors, explicit 'Required' labels, and stronger delete confirmations for prod (type-to-confirm). Thoughts?

Priya Shah: +1 on inline-on-blur; worried about mobile clutter. Maybe hide inline until blur or after first submit.

Jamal Ortiz: Eng: inline-on-blur OK. API should return stable errors like {location:'field'|'form', field:'name', message:'...'} so client can attach. For non-field server errors, top summary with anchors works.

Emily Ruiz: A11y: connect errors with inputs via aria-describedby; announce critical errors (role='alert' or aria-live). For required add visible 'Required' and sr-only 'This field is required'. Modal dialogs must trap focus and announce when opened.

Robin Park: Plan: extend FormField with props errorText, requiredLabel, showInlineOn. Add data-error-anchor ids for top summary links. Prototype branch r/feat/form-validation-patterns.

Alex Chen: Delete confirms: propose tiered confirms — simple modal for non-prod, type-to-confirm for prod or high-traffic resources. Include consequences + link to audit logs.

Priya Shah: Tiering sounds good. Don't force type-to-confirm always. Copy should state irreversible consequences and show resource name.

Emily Ruiz: For type-to-confirm, label the input, include sr-only instructions, ensure keyboard users can cancel; announce modal open via live region.

Jamal Ortiz: Keep Escape to cancel; require exact typed match to enable delete button. Also include focus_hint boolean in API error payloads so client can focus.

Robin Park: I'll prototype components, a11y behaviors, and unit/e2e tests. Will open PR and tag UX/a11y for review.

deploy-bot: preview-deploy created for r/feat/form-validation-patterns — https://deploy-preview/redwood/1234

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — please review Figma and PR. :thumbsup:
